items.name: sta_rigor
items.gate_note: sign-off STA must carry OCV derate + recovery/removal + min-pulse-width — a bare setup/hold-MET report is optimistic.

items.name: lvs_report
items.gate_note: genuine netgen `Circuits match uniquely` required — a POWER_PIN_ONLY waiver is NOT a tapeout LVS pass.

items.name: em_density
items.gate_note: real per-segment J vs the PDK Jmax limit — replaces the decap-count proxy; absent Jmax reference → SKIP, never a pass.

items.name: mbist_wrapper
items.gate_note: every writable on-chip RAM needs a March-test MBIST wrapper (N/A when the design is RAM-less).

items.name: dynamic_ir_report
items.gate_note: transient (di/dt) IR droop vs a %-of-Vdd budget — distinct from the static IR row; absent dynamic report → SKIP, never the static report read as a dynamic pass.

items.name: metal_layer_density
items.gate_note: PER-LAYER metal density within the foundry CMP window (Efabless met_min_ca_density) — the row/core-util density.rpt is a different axis and is NOT a substitute.

items.name: aging_sta_report
items.gate_note: aging-derated STA (NBTI/PBTI/HCI Vt-drift) worst slack >= margin — no foundry aging Liberty → honest SKIP, never a fabricated aging number.

items.name: thermal_screen
items.gate_note: first-order power-density screen (W/mm², + Tj when available) — power not_computed / no die area → honest SKIP.

items.name: dft_signoff
items.gate_note: aggregate DFT sign-off: stuck-at recomputed vs the foundry floor + a real/documented-engine-limited at-speed transition record + a BSDL for a padded design.

items.name: lec_post_layout
items.gate_note: the FINAL routed/ECO netlist re-proven logically == synth/RTL (Step-13 only proved RTL==synth) — a non-proof is a FAIL, not a pass.

items.name: mpw_precheck
items.gate_note: Efabless/chipIgnite shuttle verdict — every required precheck stage must carry an explicit PASS (Caravel/Open-MPW only).

items.name: layout_xor
items.gate_note: computed GDS-vs-golden XOR with an EXPLICIT blackbox-macro waiver allow-list — replaces the hardcoded 2/7 floor.

notes: This checklist is a derived inventory of present artefacts. BLOCKER items missing here MUST be authored before tape-out. Rows carrying a `gate` are SUBSTANCE-gated, not presence-only: the LVS row requires a GENUINE netgen match (a POWER_PIN_ONLY waiver is NOT a tapeout pass), EM is real J-vs-Jmax (not the decap-count proxy), STA must carry OCV+recovery/removal+MPW rigor, every writable RAM needs an MBIST wrapper, and Caravel shuttle submissions must pass the mpw-precheck + a computed XOR. Those gates run in `signoff_ladder_run --mode tapeout` (see each row's `gate` / `gate_note`); this generator does not re-validate their content. Foundry-side acceptance of mask spec, WAT plan, scribe layout, corner test kit is also enforced by foundry_handoff_package_check (Step 38, v2.3).
